offering_description.value: Provides residential and commercial residential property insurance, mainly homeowners and condo association coverage in Florida, through its UPC Insurance subsidiary and other carriers. It sells through independent agents and manages risk using reinsurance. It also earns fees from managing policies and claims.

primary_products.value: homeowners insurance; condominium association property insurance; commercial residential property insurance; flood insurance

primary_services.value: insurance underwriting; claims handling; policy administration and managing general agent services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Florida homeowners and other individual residential policyholders; B2B: condominium associations and apartment owners buying commercial residential coverage

end_markets.value: residential property insurance; commercial residential real estate; Florida coastal housing

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums earned on property insurance policies and investment income; commissions or management fees: policy and claims management fees and commissions
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: risk-bearing insurance carrier buying reinsurance, selling property policies to homeowners and associations; service provider: managing general agent and claims administration

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily Florida, with some Gulf and Atlantic coast states

specialization.value: related lines: residential, condo and commercial residential property insurance plus related agency and claims services

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents placing policies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance carrier regulated by state insurance departments such as the Florida Office of Insurance Regulation, with rate and solvency rules

notes: Mix of lines and states served is approximate.
